label: Specification for: VALIDATION_ESTABLISHMENTMEANS_STANDARD
description: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:establishmentMeans is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:establishmentMeans is in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT. bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "Establishment Means Controlled Vocabulary List of Terms" {[https://dwc.tdwg.org/em/]} {GBIF vocabulary API [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/EstablishmentMeans/concepts]}
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:establishmentMeans is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:establishmentMeans is in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT.
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "Establishment Means Controlled Vocabulary List of Terms" {[https://dwc.tdwg.org/em/]} {GBIF vocabulary API [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/EstablishmentMeans/concepts]}
example1: dwc:establishmentMeans="cultivated": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:establishmentMeans not found in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"
example2: dwc:establishmentMeans="native": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:establishmentMeans found in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"

label: Specification for: AMENDMENT_ESTABLISHMENTMEANS_STANDARDIZED
description: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:establishmentMeans is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:establishmentMeans if it can be unambiguously matched to a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "Establishment Means Controlled Vocabulary List of Terms" {[https://dwc.tdwg.org/em/]} {GBIF vocabulary API [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/EstablishmentMeans/concepts]}
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:establishmentMeans is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:establishmentMeans if it can be unambiguously matched to a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "Establishment Means Controlled Vocabulary List of Terms" {[https://dwc.tdwg.org/em/]} {GBIF vocabulary API [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/EstablishmentMeans/concepts]}
example1: dwc:establishmentMeans="cultivated": Response.status=NOT_AMENDED, Response.result="", Response.comment="dwc:establishmentMeans is not an interpretable value in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"
example2: dwc:establishmentMeans="vag.": Response.status=AMENDED, Response.result=dwc:establishmentMeans="vagrant", Response.comment="dwc:establishmentMeans contains an interpretable value in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"
